sloka: सो ऽहं वनमिदं प्राप्तो निर्जनं लक्ष्मणान्वित: ।सीतया चाप्रतिद्वन्द्व: सत्यवादे स्थित: पितु: ॥ २.१०७.८॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ vanamidaṁ prāpto nirjanaṁ lakṣmaṇānvita: ।sītayā cāpratidvandva: satyavāde sthita: pitu: ॥ 2.107.8॥

translations.english: I have come to this lonely forest accompanied by Lakshmana and Sita, bent upon upholding the truth of our unrivalled father's words.
